prompt:
text
Build a deliberately narrow, premium personal substitute for the core loop of Ayoa, focusing on bridging the gap between thinking and doing without the enterprise bloat.
Use exactly this stack: React + TypeScript + Vite + IndexedDB.
Primary job: Build an exceptionally polished, browser-based visual workspace that seamlessly integrates organic mind mapping with task management.
Core Features:
- Implement a flexible, infinite-canvas mind map editor with drag-and-drop nodes, organic curved connections, keyboard shortcuts, and smooth panning/zooming.
- Integrate a task management system that pulls actionable nodes from the mind map into a structured "My Planner" view (Now, Next, Soon) and a basic Kanban board.
- Include a simulated AI brainstorm assistant (using a mock API or local LLM integration if requested) to generate or expand on node ideas.
- Provide SVG/PNG export for mind maps and JSON export for task data.
Design & Aesthetics:
- Create a stunning, premium UI with a sleek dark mode by default, utilizing glassmorphism effects for menus and floating toolbars.
- Use a curated, harmonious color palette with vibrant, tailored HSL colors for different mind map branches to stimulate visual thinking.
- Incorporate smooth micro-animations for node creation, connection drawing, and task state changes.
- Use modern typography (e.g., Inter or Outfit) and ensure accessible keyboard navigation, labels, focus states, and sensible contrast.
Technical Constraints:
- Start from an empty folder and create the complete working project.
- Make the default mode single-user and private. Store user data locally in IndexedDB.
- Do not add analytics, telemetry, ads, or third-party accounts.
- Put every secret and external credential in .env and provide .env.example.
- Use realistic sample data that is clearly labelled and easy to delete.
- Include clear empty, loading, validation, success, and failure states.
- Deliberately exclude high-fidelity import/export, multiplayer cursors, presentation modes, and team chat.
- Write focused unit tests for the data model (node connections, task transitions) and add one end-to-end smoke test.
- Create a README with setup, permissions, architecture, data location, backup, and limitations.
- Add scripts for install, development, test, build, and a production-style local run. Run the tests and build before finishing, fixing any errors.
